description: A three-panel composite of vertical bar charts comparing the predictive performance of seven machine-learning models for yield-strength (YS) prediction; all three panels share the same x-axis category order: DT, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, Extra Trees, KNN, AdaBoost, with "Models" printed as the x-axis label and dashed vertical guide lines separating the categories. (a) is titled "RMSE Comparison" with the y-axis labelled RMSE, plotted on a 0-180 scale with ticks every 20; printed bar values are DT 123, XGBoost 90.4, LightGBM 104.8, CatBoost 89.5, Extra Trees 76.2, KNN 85.2, AdaBoost 162.5. (b) is titled "MAPE Comparison", y-axis MAPE on a 0-35 scale with ticks every 5; values are DT 19, XGBoost 13.4, LightGBM 12.7, CatBoost 10.2, Extra Trees 9.8, KNN 10.4, AdaBoost 33.1. (c) is titled "R² Comparison", y-axis R² on a 0.0-1.0 scale with ticks every 0.2; values are DT 0.944, XGBoost 0.969, LightGBM 0.959, CatBoost 0.97, Extra Trees 0.978, KNN 0.973, AdaBoost 0.901. Bars are colour-coded per model identically across panels. The figure demonstrates that Extra Trees simultaneously attains the lowest RMSE and MAPE and the highest R² among the seven models, while AdaBoost is clearly the worst on all three metrics.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is a bar chart titled 'RMSE Comparison' with y-axis 'RMSE' spanning 0-180 in 20-unit ticks and x-axis 'Models'.
In (a) the Extra Trees bar carries the lowest printed RMSE value, 76.2, and the AdaBoost bar the highest, 162.5.
In (a) the printed RMSE values are DT 123, XGBoost 90.4, LightGBM 104.8, CatBoost 89.5, Extra Trees 76.2, KNN 85.2, AdaBoost 162.5.

Panel (b) is a bar chart titled 'MAPE Comparison' with y-axis 'MAPE' spanning 0-35 in 5-unit ticks; printed values are DT 19, XGBoost 13.4, LightGBM 12.7, CatBoost 10.2, Extra Trees 9.8, KNN 10.4, AdaBoost 33.1.

Panel (c) is a bar chart titled 'R² Comparison' with y-axis 'R²' spanning 0.0-1.0 in 0.2 ticks; printed values are DT 0.944, XGBoost 0.969, LightGBM 0.959, CatBoost 0.97, Extra Trees 0.978, KNN 0.973, AdaBoost 0.901.
All three panels use the identical seven model categories in the same order, DT, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, Extra Trees, KNN, AdaBoost, with dashed vertical guide lines between categories.
The caption identifies the figure as 'Fig. 5. Model performance comparison metrics plot: (a)RMSE; (b)MAPE; (c)R².'
The citing text states that among the seven machine-learning models trained simultaneously, the Extra Trees model performed best, with an RMSE of 76.2 MPa, a MAPE of 9.8 %, and an R² of 0.978.
The citation gives the unit of RMSE as MPa, whereas the panel (a) y-axis label shows only 'RMSE' with no unit printed.
The citation states that the three evaluation metrics (RMSE, MAPE and R²) were compared visually to screen for the best-performing model among the seven models used for YS prediction.
AdaBoost is the worst performer in all three panels in the pixels: highest RMSE (162.5), highest MAPE (33.1) and lowest R² (0.901).
